notes: Deploy Handle with no constructor arguments, then NameRegistry with the deployed Handle address. Neither contract has an owner or administrator; no initialization calls are required. NameRegistry charges its immutable 100 HNDL fee for registration or renewal of 365-day leases. Annual fee shares use permissionless batched snapshots of distinct holder addresses; claims require a currently held live name. Snapshot completion requires callers and temporarily freezes name operations. The pool pairs with native ETH, has no hook, and uses decimal sqrtPriceX96; its initial price is not a promised market valuation. Policy, signed artifact linkage, independent review, admission and deployment are handled by the corresponding services.
